notes.title: Unleash your inner monkey: TOSS!🍌 is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=QcXWv2auBpQ;full][/previewyoutube]
TOSS IS OUT NOW!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1270460/TOSS/

TOSS!🍌 has been with us for close to five years, and it's difficult to put into words just how excited we are to finally share it with all of you.

The sheer love and effort we've poured into making TOSS!🍌 is something we will remember as part of this amazing time, and the tons of feedback and encouragement we have gotten from you - the awesome players - is what has been pushing us.

We are super proud of what we've accomplished, and thrilled to continue our journey on TOSS!🍌 together with you!

WHAT TO EXPECT

Swing and toss yourself freely across spacey jungle-gym playgrounds, as an acrobatic monkey, in this bananas VR platformer.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38317939/63b9cc960ff7d4201aa1299f0c7b997d02b9f3da.png

You've crash landed on a cloud planet and will need to collect parts to repair your ship as you launch yourself around 75+ playground levels in 9 vibrant cloudscape biomes and rank-up to become a TOSS!🍌 master.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38317939/9a8747638a93f76034cfd6c21c764b6d4f05a0bd.png

This VR game uniquely captures the agility, timing and gamer skill required to play the beloved platformer classics.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38317939/dec52a3ce7cbe9fba8a579781126c12cf7c43146.png


🐵 PARKOUR ACTION: Soar and launch yourselves through the air, grab hold of trees, pipes, and walls.

🔥 CHALLENGES: Try to race against the clock, with Time Attack; find as many bananas as possible or master as few grabs as possible in each round.

🍌 SOCIAL COMPETITION: Compete against each other by time and rank, and follow your friends' leaderboard ghosts.

🥋 MASTERY & MODIFIERS: Unlock modifiers like Zero Gravity and Double Toss by becoming a TOSS!🍌 master!

GRAB IT NOW
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1270460/TOSS/

-- Albin, Simon, Eddie & Toss

notes.title: Announcing Unplugged VR and updates on After the Fall!
notes.content:
E3 2021 is happening in full force and part of it are some exciting updates from Vertigo Games!

AFTER THE FALL
Over the past weeks, we've done some Closer Look updates giving a glimpse on After the Fall gameplay, like details on the Enemies & Combat, and how Replayability and Cross-play work in After the Fall.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3l1ABr0Jm2M
There's a lot more to show and tell, stay tuned for that in the future!

Unplugged VR

Get ready to rock in Fall 2021! After announcing it for Oculus Quest, Unplugged is coming to SteamVR as well! Rock out to world-famous bands like The Offspring and more!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=l6Q0PMJqLrE
Stay up to date on everything Unplugged at unplugged-vr.com

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1623390/Unplugged/

notes.title: First Gameplay Reveal teaser for After the Fall!
notes.content:
4-PLAYER VR CO-OP IN ACTION

Time to shine. Vertigo Games is excited to reveal the first glimpse at After the Fall gameplay! Ever since releasing the cinematic trailer, we've been undying to bring true VR co-op action. We're also excited to announce that in addition to PlayStation VR and PC VR, After the Fall will also be available on the Oculus Quest platform this Summer.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=d67dC6mLyqI

INTENSE VR CO-OP ACTION

After the Fall offers cross-platform co-op, which means you can team up with your friends, no matter what VR platform they're on!


NOT YOUR AVERAGE UNDEAD

You will need your friends to team up with against the Snowbreed, who come in different, terrifying shapes and sizes!

Wishlist it now! >> https://store.steampowered.com/app/751630/After_the_Fall/
